reader.title: Case appointment letter from a social-assistance office
reader.what_it_is: A letter setting an appointment with your caseworker. Missing it without notice may delay your assistance.
reader.what_it_asks: Go to 700 Queen Street East, 2nd floor, on Tuesday, September 22, 2026 at 10:30 a.m. Bring photo identification and proof of your rent (your lease or a rent receipt). If you cannot attend, call (416) 555-0188 before the appointment to reschedule.

interpreter.target_text: Esta carta le da una cita con su trabajador o trabajadora de caso en la oficina de Queen Street East. Si falta sin avisar, su ayuda podría retrasarse. Lleve identificación con foto y prueba de su alquiler. Si no puede ir, llame antes para cambiar la cita.
interpreter.back_translation: This letter gives you an appointment with your caseworker at the office on Queen Street East. If you miss it without notice, your assistance could be delayed. Bring photo ID and proof of your rent. If you cannot go, call ahead to change the appointment.

drafter.title: Reminder card: case appointment

APPOINTMENT: Tuesday, September 22, 2026 at 10:30 a.m.
WHERE: 700 Queen Street East, 2nd floor
BRING: photo identification; proof of your rent (your lease or a rent receipt)
IF YOU CANNOT ATTEND: call (416) 555-0188 before the appointment to reschedule.
